notes.title: Major update: HD version!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303202/bae324c782d3074cabfb242bac6a5d2fb0521e1c.jpg[/img]
Work on the game is moving towards release, and we continue to improve the demo version of the game. Meet the HD update, which fixes numerous shortcomings of the early version!
[list]
[*] [b]+20% to FPS.[/b] Due to the integration of a wrapper for modern versions of DirectX, the game now functions much faster!
[*] [b]New HDR lighting.[/b] The lighting system received a major update, due to which the "pitch black syndrome" was defeated on a number of configurations.
[*] [b]Numerous bug fixes. [/b]Fixed a number of issues with collisions, freezes and level drops.
[*] [b]Interface improvements.[/b] The game is now clearer and easier to control than before.
[*] [b]Auto-detect of settings.[/b] New players will now be offered a settings configuration tailored to your computer.
[/list]

[u][b]Please try the new version![/b][/u]

notes.title: EAX Patch - a fantastic update!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303202/1e8e87f2836a08c998c585e526318a758433ac18.jpg[/img]
[b]We've worked a lot, and made a giant patch to our demo[/b]. 
New things are:
[list]
[*] A support for a groundbreaking EAX sound technology - a golden classics of surrounding sound from 2000-s. The DSOAL library helped us a lot. Our engine doesn't have a [b]full [/b]EAX support, and your system could have some problems with it - so this feature is still experimental. Enable it with great care in Option menu!
[*] Menu system overhaul - now everything's a bit better: new Options (like mouse inversion), auto-skip system for intro, better visuals. Also, new players would see a new menu for Quality/Performance and EAX settings.
[*] Fixes for annoying fall-through-level problem. Now it won't break your gameplay anymore.
[*] Fixes for Infernus gun. Now it won't slow down your PC so much.
[*] Daemonic Shotgun and Infernus were rebalanced.
[*] Roboskulls and Slayers were tuned down a bit.
[*] Fixes for gamma and logging system, other small bugfixes.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303202/f5472bdad215eb35ba267395dc4db3fce4757c4a.png[/img]
[b]Go and play![/b]

notes.title: Patch 2.0.0.3
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303202/9da14e57f3fbd561e4e4f1916f0af654975fd15a.jpg[/img]
[h1]We've fixed some annoying problems in our demo[/h1]
[list]
[*] Gamma level setting haven't worked as intended.
[*] Monsters were able to hurt player during his reading of tutorial screens.
[/list]

[h2]Also we've added a new functional for logging in v.2.0.0.3. [/h2]
If you have problems, please enable "Produce logs" in options. This will activate a special "yellow" loading screen. When game ends, it would consequently open two files of logs in a Notepad (second one could be missing). Please copy that texts and send to us. It would help us a lot!

notes.title: We fixed everything!
notes.notes:
Get ready to dive back into action! We've worked hard and the latest version contains lots of bugfixes and improvements for a smoother, more immersive gaming experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43303202/747a6deb8789801f0adb49b4bca0f3e91256280a.png[/img]

[h2]The new version boasts the following improvements:[/h2]

[h3]Errors:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed crashes when loading on some PC configurations.
[*] Memory consumption has been reduced - [b]now the game is 10% more efficient and faster[/b].
[*] Volume controls have been fixed - now the sound and music settings work.
[*] Compilation of shaders has been fixed, and the shaders themselves are cached (by levels).
[*] Fixed freezes on the shader compilation screen.
[*] Post-processing has been speeded up (but if its still slow, please let us know!).
[*] Fixed a bug with shadows that led to a loss of performance.
[/list]

[h3]Gameplay:[/h3]
[list]
[*] When a character loses a life and gets up again, he now automatically draws a weapon.
[*] The speed of water rise and the number of enemies in the “Corridor of death” has been reduced.
[*] The player character now automatically switches to a new weapon when he finds one.
[*] Now a full pistol cannot be reloaded.
[*] Blasterman stopped falling into the floor [i](we hope)[/i].
[*] Fixed a bug with a player appearing with a crowbar and changing it to the desired weapon.
[*] Fixed the incorrect appearance of a monster on the second path in “Vertical Hell”.
[/list]

[h3]Other:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Tooltips in Option menu have been improved. They've always been there, but it was so difficult to see...
[*] Fixed problems with choosing an incorrect resolution where the current resolution is lower than the maximum availible for monitor.
[*] Resolutions that the game itself does not support are now blocked.
[*] Fixed the URL for loading PhysX drivers when trying to launch in PhysX mode on a system without installed drivers.
[/list]

[b]Now go and show the hellish creatures what you are worth![/b]
For feedback and chat with friends - [url=https://discord.gg/A2ez5gxjzz]Discord server of the game[/url].
